Budget Tracker: Added setting Budget Reminders, which lets you set an interval to be reminded after and a mode by which to get a reminder.
You can also choose specific days of the month on which to get a reminder, instead of picking a repeating interval.
When there is an active reminder, the tool's sidebar listing and Home card will flash, and a message will display at the top of the tool.
Auto-Backup: Added ability to set reminders on specific days of the month, instead of choosing specific repeating intervals.
Countdown Timer: Added new tool that gives you a big pretty countdown timer.
Visually persists during focus-loss / obfuscation, so you can pop this up on a screen-share during a meeting break, but then go do your Amazon ordering in peace.
Customize the timer style and alert sound via the Setup modal.
Add memo notes to track what a timer was for, and see a historical log of timer runs.
Historical timer runs have a button to add their event to the Time Tracker tool as a logged entry, allowing for Pomodoro use.
You also have the ability to create presets for your most frequent timers.
Game Stats: Added new tool that allows tracking stats of games, starting with Five Crowns.
Import existing game data via Excel or enter manually.
See individual player stats and compare them against others they've played against.
See stats at the 'table' level, where a table is a set grouping of specific player profiles.
Days Between Dates: Added new tool that allows for input of a starting and ending date, and gives the number of elapsed days after the start date.
Shows breakdowns in raw days, as well as weeks, hours, minutes, and more.
Has option to include the start date in the calculation, useful for counting booking stays.
TTS Repeater: Added new tool that lets you input a message and have a Text-to-Speech voice repeat it.
Can set it to repeat every so many seconds or minutes, as well as to run a certain number of times or endlessly.
Choose the built-in voice you wish to use for the spoken message, including adjusting its Rate, Pitch, and Volume.
Includes a Display View if you need an audio-accessible stream screen for events or large calls.
You can customize the look and feel of the Display View from Setup, including choosing a theme-related style or going your own way with a custom style.
You can save presets for messages you intend to broadcast frequently.

Improved consistency of toasts firing for similar actions and consistency of their message formatting.

When customizing the Sidebar, you can now snap tools into five ordering modes: Classic, Sort A-Z, Sort Z-A, Most Recent, and Most Used, the latter of which is determined by number of times a tool is accessed.
Added ability to set volume for notification toasts when picking a sound pack, including ability to Mute toasts.
Budget Tracker: When clicking on a recurring bill to pay it, renamed modal to 'Pay {BillName}'.
When encryption is enabled and set to 'on every tool entry', a Windows system lock screen also locks the budget tracker.
Auto-Backup: Backup Reminders now flash the tool on the sidebar and Home Card, and display a message at the top of the tool.

Budget Tracker: Fixed labels in the Add/Edit/Pay {BillName} modals being centered instead of left-aligned.

Projects and Activities are now saved in the Setup modal, and can be edited, which changes the name for all entries using that Project / Activity.
Editing a Project / Activity Name to one already in use allows you to merge projects / activities.
If you manually type a new Project / Activity name into its field, it'll automatically be saved as a known Project / Activity in the Setup modal.
Previously used / 'known' Projects / Activities show under their fields as you type, allowing quick selection for repeat events.
Added an End Date field to the Input panel, allowing for multi-day events.
Added support for timestamps being captured to the exact second.
Added setting under Preferences to 'Round 'Now' to Whole Minute'.

App Overall: Added ability to opt-in to New Version Notifications from General Settings.
This is the first and only time this app ever makes a network call; it pings GitHub to see the latest released version.
This happens once on app launch, and also once when you enable this setting (so you don't have to relaunch to check).
If the version you're on is older than the latest released version, the top bar of the Home Page will indicate an update is available and link to the About modal.
The button to launch the About modal will also pulsate to indicate that a newer version is available.
You can quickly get to the GitHub Releases Page from this notification in the About modal.
From the About Modal, you can also select to Ignore This Version if you want to skip updating this version, but still get future update available notifications.

This feature is opt-in, off by default, and can be disabled at any time after enabling. No data ever leaves your device; this is a read-only check on GitHub for the sole purpose of checking the latest available Release.
When a Random Theme is chosen, added button next to Reroll Theme to be able to save the randomly generated palette as a Custom Theme.
The saved Custom Theme can then be used / modified by switching the theme from Random to Custom, and choosing the timestamped save from the list of Custom Themes.
Updated / modernized all themes to better reflect current tools and implementations.
Overhauled the Retro-Electric theme to be more visually contrasting.
Made Random Theme's Regenerative mode more responsive to stimuli.
Made the rainbow theme more vivid.
Christmas and Halloween themes now have special animations.
Auto-Backup: Added ability to hide progress details, allowing running of backups to go faster.
If a file gets skipped, it's now separately logged and viewable in a modal.
Added warning to the confirmation modal if destination drive doesn't exist / there's not enough free space.
Image CCR: Added parallel threading so that the resize operation would run faster.
Tools now show their panels locked when there's not enough files chosen, instead of not showing them at all.
Resize tool can now handle inputs of one or more selected files, not just folders.
Resize tool's canvas color, Combine tool's canvas and border colors can now be set to transparent, when creating a PNG image.

Set month-based Income Expectations and Expense Thresholds to help you reach financial goals.
View various stats and metrics to analyze how and where your money is going, and know how much you need each month to live.

App Overall: New Theme Added - Terminal.
Added ability to create and manage Custom themes via the Settings modal.
Can create a new theme, base it off an existing one, and then modify set colors and other styles.
Added General Setting 'App Lock', allowing you to set a pin / password to solely control opening of the app and accessing its tools.
Dummy File Generator: Added new tool that allows you to quickly generate multiple dummy files for testing purposes.
Can be used to generate batches of files of various file types - text files will have text added into their files.
When generating multiple batches, you can choose to generate all files in one folder, sort the output by extension, or sort by line.
Selecting '123', 'abc', or '0xF' specifies how the filenames should increment - either numerically, alphabetically, or hexadecimally.
You can also add a filename prefix or suffix to all generated files in a batch.
For the extension type, you can either manually type in an extension, or use the in-field extension picker to choose an extension from the popup modal.
Image CCR: For Combine, added ability to preview combinations before saving.
Added ability to define a gap between images if you don't want them combined right next to eachother.
Added ability to add a border around the combined images, defining the border thickness and color.
Added Canvas Color, so you can define the color of the extra space around the combined images, inside the border.
Added output filetype options of JPG and PNG when combining images.
Added the Resize tab to the Image CCR tool.
Resize allows you to select a folder of one or more images and homogenize their width, height, or complete canvas size.
Using 'Resize To' proportionately scales the image to the specified dimensions.
Using 'Set manual canvas size' allows definition of the end file's exact dimensions, within which the optionally resized image will be placed.

Image CCR: Added new tool to the Files Category that allows the user to combine images or compress an image.
Combine mode allows you to select multiple image files and append them to eachother in a specified direction.
The first image is the anchor image - you then choose a direction below by which to add subsequent images to the anchor image.
Compress mode allows you to select one image and shrink its size / dimensions quickly and easily for uploading to websites with filesize constraints.
Auto-Backup: Added new tool that allows you to define one or many source folders and one or multiple destination folders for a backup.
Browse for folders via Windows, or add raw paths manually. You can also double-click a path to inline edit it.
Uses Windows' robocopy utility to mirror the entirety of the source folder(s) (and any subfolders / files) to each of the Destination folders.
Only new / modified files get mirrored over to save time. If the Destination folder already has the same file, it will be skipped.
Note that the point of this tool is to exactly 'mirror' the Source folder structure / contents into the Destination.
For future backups, this means that files changed in the Source will overwrite older versions in the Destination.
This also means that files that are no longer in the Source will be removed from the Destination.
You can create Presets of commonly used Source / Destination Folder setups.
Stats show in the Summary section, including an 'overestimate' of time to complete the backup.
Backup progress is then shown in the Last Run section at the bottom. A summary log .txt file is included in the first Destination folder provided.
